limitations: No HTTP request was made for the 27 external links per language.
Automatic heading fragments are treated as candidates, not certified from an assumed GitHub/Pandoc slug equivalence; none is used by the current local links.
Exact historical filenames and the author name are retained for provenance; they are not untranslated mathematical prose.
A zero residual-CJK result would not itself prove translation completeness or mathematical equivalence.
The report is valid for the two exact Markdown SHA256 values; a later manuscript change requires an updated check.
